entityTypes.name: subject
entityTypes.description: One rat, named in the folder and the file names (Ramachandran, Taskmaster, Turing). The data descriptor calls this level Animal_name.

entityTypes.name: session
entityTypes.description: One recording session in the Touch and See task: spiking from V2m, S1bf, perirhinal cortex and CA1 with video-tracked position, stored as one pickled Neo block. The data descriptor: 'session.pkl: pickled Neo block containing spiking and position data of the session.' Sessions are numbered samp1 to samp46 across all rats.

session_id.name: session_id
session_id.title: Session
session_id.description: samp<N>, the name of the session's folder, repeated in the file name.

session_date.name: session_date
session_date.title: Session date
session_date.description: The yyyy-MM-dd date at the end of the file name.

dataLocations.description: Bos et al., multi-area recordings from visual and somatosensory cortices, perirhinal cortex and hippocampal CA1 (dataset version 2077efac-09f6-47c1-aabe-632e08ed148b). The dataset is the folder hbp-01681/ of a bucket shared with other data. Layout: hbp-01681/TouchAndSee/<animal>/samp<N>/hbp-01681_TouchAndSee_<animal>_samp<N>__<yyyy-MM-dd>.pkl, with an example notebook and script in TouchAndSee/, and the data descriptor, the licence and hbp-01681.json in hbp-01681/. The data descriptor's registry describes a different layout, touch_and_see/data/<Animal_name>/<Session>/session.pkl with data/maze_outline.pkl and examples/; the bucket has neither maze_outline.pkl nor examples/. Every entry below hbp-01681/ was listed.

filePatterns.name: neo_block
filePatterns.description: Pickled Neo block with spiking and position data
